summary: The reported commands use the finite compile_deep_gemm precompiler rather than the persistent launch_server entrypoint. Its post-warmup shutdown is intentional, while the supplied resource_tracker warnings do not expose the preceding cause. Upstream PR 32444's process-wide resource tracking disablement was rejected as overbroad. No issue-specific product correction was justified on the available topology.

tests.what_was_measured: The actual source entrypoint loaded the model, allocated KV cache, executed its compile-deep-gemm warmup on gfx950, and reached application startup. A local port bind collision then prevented a clean finite exit; the owned run was terminated and is retained only as negative boundary evidence.
Five Mooncake transfer batching tests and three subtests passed, covering short-transfer legacy behavior, custom-memory-pool behavior, sliced indices, failure stopping, and device-page indices.
One-GPU FP16 matrix multiplication on gfx950 agreed with an independent CPU FP32 reference at rtol=0.01, atol=0.02 (maximum absolute error 0.02323150634765625).

gpu_execution.evidence: The actual compile_deep_gemm child log records model loading, GPU KV-cache allocation, Triton compilation warnings for gfx950, and a completed prefill warmup. The independent numerical boundary identifies AMD Instinct MI350X / gfx950 and passes against CPU FP32.

remaining_limitations: No GLM-5.2-W4AFP8 weights were available; the tiny random Llama cannot validate that architecture, quantization, speculative decoding, or semantic accuracy.
Only one gfx950 GPU was assigned; TP8, EP8, attention CP8, and the reported one-prefill/one-decode distributed workload were not reproduced.
No second host or matching four-HCA RDMA fabric was available, so Mooncake RDMA and the combined Mooncake HiCache plus PD-transfer path remain unverified.
The issue contains only resource_tracker shutdown warnings and omits the preceding root exception/traceback.
The tiny compile_deep_gemm boundary encountered a local port bind collision after successful GPU warmup and was terminated; it is not claimed as a clean reproduction or fix verification.
No native source was changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
